newsitem.title: INDIA: Quake kills 17 in central India - radio.
newsitem.headline: Quake kills 17 in central India - radio.

text.p: A severe earthquake hit central India on Thursday, killing at least 17 people and injuring about 150, All India Radio said.
The state radio station said the quake, which measured about 6.0 on the Richter scale, damaged several hundred houses when it struck in the early morning hours in Madhya Pradesh State.
A spokesman of the Madhya Pradesh government in the state capital Bhopal confirmed to Reuters that 17 people have been killed and 90 have suffered injuries in the quake.
He said most of the deaths had occurred due to house collapses in the rural areas near Jabalpur.
A Meteorological Department official in New Delhi told Reuters an earthquake had been recorded near Jabalpur, about 260 km from Bhopal, at 4.22 a.m. (2252 GMT Wednesday).
"The quake measuring 6.0 on the Richter scale was felt in several parts of Madhya Pradesh," the official said.
